commits.author: kbhujbal
commits.message:
Fix regression bugs: MapStruct Spring integration, MongoDB driver mismatch, and test infrastructure

- Add componentModel="spring" to all 7 MapStruct mappers (was missing, causing NoSuchBeanDefinition at runtime)
- Remove conflicting mongodb-driver-sync 4.6.1 override from root pom (was causing NoClassDefFoundError with Spring Boot 3.2.3's driver 4.11.1)
- Remove redundant spring-boot-starter-data-redis version override from root pom
- Add -parameters flag to maven-compiler-plugin (required by Spring Boot 3.2+ for @PathVariable resolution)
- Add embedded MongoDB (flapdoodle) test dependency to review-service for CI-compatible integration tests
- Fix review-service application-test.yml: correct port, remove stale eureka config, configure embedded MongoDB
- Fix integration test assertions for @RequestBody String handling

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: kbhujbal
commits.message:
Replace Eureka with Kubernetes native service discovery

- Remove eureka-server module entirely (4 files deleted)
- Remove spring-cloud-starter-netflix-eureka-client from all 10 pom.xml
- Remove eureka config blocks from all 9 application.yml files
- Remove @EnableDiscoveryClient from all 9 Application classes
- Replace lb:// URIs in API Gateway with config-injected direct URLs
- Update Feign clients with explicit URL config (services.product.url, etc.)
- Remove spring.cloud.gateway.discovery.locator (no longer needed)
- Update docker-compose.yml: remove eureka-server, add service URL env vars
- Add 16 Kubernetes manifests in k8s/ directory:
  - namespace, configmap, secrets
  - mongodb, redis, elasticsearch (Deployment + Service + PVC each)
  - 9 application services (Deployment + Service each)
  - ingress for external traffic routing
- Delete outdated review-service/k8s/ manifests
- All 11 modules compile successfully without Eureka

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: kbhujbal
commits.message:
Complete backend: add infrastructure services, JWT auth, fix bugs, and implement all features

- Add Eureka Discovery Server (port 8761) for service registration
- Add API Gateway (port 8080) with route definitions for all 9 services
- Implement JWT authentication with login/register/refresh endpoints
- Add JwtAuthenticationFilter in API Gateway for protected routes
- Create JwtUtil in common module, SecurityConfig and JwtAuthFilter in user-service
- Fix payment-service pom.xml (was empty) with all required dependencies
- Fix Product model dual @Document annotation conflict
- Fix ShipmentServiceImpl recursive call bug (renamed to computeCost)
- Fix ReviewServiceImpl null Pageable bug
- Fix Stripe SDK v24 compatibility (getLatestCharge + Charge.retrieve)
- Fix port conflicts: order-service 8082, review-service 8088
- Fix duplicate spring.data YAML keys in all service configs
- Standardize application.yml with env var defaults for Docker/local
- Complete cart-service TODOs: tax (8%), shipping ($5.99/free >$50), coupons
- Complete notification-service: SMS/push stubs with proper status tracking
- Complete shipping-service: weight-based cost calculation, label generation
- Add Feign clients: ProductServiceClient, NotificationServiceClient
- Enable @EnableFeignClients on order-service and cart-service
- Update docker-compose.yml with correct ports, env vars, healthchecks
- Create UserServiceApplication.java (was missing)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
